name: Gen Matrix
tagline: Every model. Every style. Side by side.
description:
Gen Matrix runs one prompt across a grid of models and styles, so you can see side by side what each one changes.

Write a shared prompt, then choose the two axes. Rows are checkpoints — a curated starting pair plus anything you add from the in-app browser or Civitai's full resource picker. Columns are styles: cinematic, anime and watercolor modifiers alongside a plain baseline, or any LoRA added as its own column with a strength slider. Every cell is a real generation of the same prompt, so the only thing that differs is the row and column that made it.

Each cell spends Buzz, so the grid is capped at 12 cells and a live cell count and estimated total sit above the Generate button as you build. Confirming is its own step: a dialog names the exact cell count and the total before anything is spent, and every cell is charged only its real cost, usually a few Buzz. Cells run three at a time and fill in as they land. Run short mid-grid and you can top up and retry only the failures — a finished cell is never re-charged, and a LoRA the server rejects as incompatible costs nothing.

Your run is saved as it goes, so a reload rebuilds the grid with its images and per-cell costs intact.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Spends the viewer's Buzz to generate each matrix cell's image, capped by page.buzzBudgetPerGen and confirmed behind an explicit per-run estimate + Confirm step.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads back the viewer's own past matrices — the grid, its per-cell images and what each cell cost — so a reload reopens a paid run instead of losing it. Private to that viewer; the block never reads another viewer's rows.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves each matrix the viewer generates under their own private per-app storage, so a run they already paid for survives a reload and stays in their history.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Reads the app-scoped gallery of published matrices so every viewer — signed in or not — can browse the grids the app author has published, their vote totals, and whether this viewer has already voted. Read-only; the entries hold image ids and grid coordinates, and the images themselves are re-fetched per viewer through the platform's own maturity clamp.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Publishes a finished matrix into that gallery (an author-curated act the platform already restricts to app developers), and lets any signed-in viewer up-vote an entry, report one to moderators, or withdraw an entry they published themselves.
